As we operate from a rented building, we have no control over the size of the existing car park or the use of the land next door. We did explore options to expand parking capacity some years ago, including working with our local MP in 2016, but securing additional land has proven very difficult and remains outside our control.

We would absolutely like to increase parking availability if it were possible. In the meantime, we are located on a main bus route with a bus stop just outside the building, and there is also street parking available nearby for patients who need it.

Thank you again for sharing your experience and for your understanding.

Kind Regards
